title: Ātmabodha
subtitle: Sixty-eight verses on the knowledge of the Self

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, Volume 15 (Miscellaneous Prakaranas, vol. 1), Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0 Universal; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
तपोभिः क्षीणपापानां शान्तानां वीतरागिणाम् ।
मुमुक्षूणामपेक्ष्योऽयमात्मबोधो विधीयते ॥
units.translation: This teaching on the Self is set forth for those who, through austerity, have exhausted their demerit, are peaceful and free from attachment, and seek liberation.

gloss.en: of those whose demerit is exhausted
teaching or knowledge of the Self

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
बोधोऽन्यसाधनेभ्यो हि साक्षान्मोक्षैकसाधनम् ।
पाकस्य वह्निवज्ज्ञानं विना मोक्षो न सिध्यति ॥
units.translation: Knowledge is the direct and sole means to liberation, unlike other means; just as cooking requires fire, liberation is not accomplished without knowledge.

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
अविरोधितया कर्म नाविद्यां विनिवर्तयेत् ।
विद्याऽविद्यां निहन्त्येव तेजस्तिमिरसङ्घवत् ॥
units.translation: Action, because it does not oppose ignorance, cannot remove ignorance. Knowledge alone destroys ignorance, as light destroys a mass of darkness.

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
अवच्छिन्न इवाज्ञानात्तन्नाशे सति केवलः ।
स्वयं प्रकाशते ह्यात्मा मेघापायेऽंशुमानिव ॥
units.translation: As though bounded because of ignorance, the Self shines by itself as the One alone when that ignorance is destroyed, like the sun when the clouds disperse.

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
अज्ञानकलुषं जीवं ज्ञानाभ्यासाद्विनिर्मलम् ।
कृत्वा ज्ञानं स्वयं नश्येज्जलं कतकरेणुवत् ॥
units.translation: Having purified the mind-clouded individual through the practice of knowledge, knowledge itself subsides, like the cleansing powder settling out of water.

gloss.en: like the powder of the kaṭaka cleansing nut

units.label: Verse 6
units.deva:
संसारः स्वप्नतुल्यो हि रागद्वेषादिसङ्कुलः ।
स्वकाले सत्यवद्भाति प्रबोधे सत्यसद्भवेत् ॥
units.translation: The cycle of worldly existence, crowded with attachment, aversion, and the rest, is indeed like a dream: it seems real while it lasts, but on awakening is seen as unreal.

gloss.en: filled with attachment, aversion, and the like

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
तावत्सत्यं जगद्भाति शुक्तिकारजतं यथा ।
यावन्न ज्ञायते ब्रह्म सर्वाधिष्ठानमद्वयम् ॥
units.translation: The world appears real only so long as Brahman, the non-dual ground of all, is not known—just as shell-silver appears real until the shell is recognized.

gloss.en: silver seen in a mother-of-pearl shell

units.label: Verse 8
units.deva:
उपादानेऽखिलाधारे जगन्ति परमेश्वरे ।
सर्गस्थितिलयान् यान्ति बुद्बुदानीव वारिणि ॥
units.translation: In the Supreme Lord, the material cause and support of all, the worlds pass through creation, maintenance, and dissolution, like bubbles in water.

units.label: Verse 9
units.deva:
सच्चिदात्मन्यनुस्यूते नित्ये विष्णौ प्रकल्पिताः ।
व्यक्तयो विविधाः सर्वा हाटके कटकादिवत् ॥
units.translation: All the many particular forms are imagined in the eternal, all-pervading Viṣṇu, whose nature is existence and consciousness, as bracelets and the like are fashioned from gold.

gloss.en: in the one whose nature is existence and consciousness

units.label: Verse 10
units.deva:
यथाकाशो हृषीकेशो नानोपाधिगतो विभुः ।
तद्भेदाद्भिन्नवद्भाति तन्नाशे केवलो भवेत् ॥
units.translation: Like space, the all-pervading Hṛṣīkeśa, associated with various limiting adjuncts, appears divided; when they are destroyed, it remains one alone.

gloss.en: Hṛṣīkeśa, the Lord of the senses

units.label: Verse 11
units.deva:
नानोपाधिवशादेव जातिनामाश्रमादयः ।
आत्मन्यारोपितास्तोये रसवर्णादिभेदवत् ॥
units.translation: Differences such as caste, name, and life-stage are superimposed on the Self through various limiting adjuncts, as differences of taste and color are imagined in water.

gloss.en: caste, name, life-stage, and the rest
as with differences of taste, color, and the like

units.label: Verse 12
units.deva:
पञ्चीकृतमहाभूतसंभवं कर्मसञ्चितम् ।
शरीरं सुखदुःखानां भोगायतनमुच्यते ॥
units.translation: The body, born from the fivefold-combined gross elements and accumulated karma, is said to be the dwelling in which pleasures and pains are experienced.

gloss.en: arising from the fivefold-combined great elements

units.label: Verse 13
units.deva:
पञ्चप्राणमनोबुद्धिदशेन्द्रियसमन्वितम् ।
अपञ्चीकृतभूतोत्थं सूक्ष्माङ्गं भोगसाधनम् ॥
units.translation: The subtle body, arising from the uncombined elements, consists of the five vital breaths, mind, intellect, and ten senses; it is the instrument for experience.

gloss.en: arising from the elements before their fivefold combination

units.label: Verse 14
units.deva:
अनाद्यविद्यानिर्वाच्या कारणोपाधिरुच्यते ।
उपाधित्रितयादन्यमात्मानमवधारयेत् ॥
units.translation: Beginningless, indefinable ignorance is called the causal limiting adjunct; one should understand the Self as distinct from the three adjuncts.

units.label: Verse 15
units.deva:
पञ्चकोशादियोगेन तत्तन्मय इव स्थितः ।
शुद्धात्मा नीलवस्त्रादियोगेन स्फटिको यथा ॥
units.translation: Through association with the five sheaths and the like, the pure Self seems to take on their nature, just as a crystal appears blue beside blue cloth.

gloss.en: through association with the five sheaths and the like
through contact with blue cloth and the like

units.label: Verse 16
units.deva:
वपुस्तुषादिभिः कोशैर्युक्तं युक्त्यवघाततः ।
आत्मानमान्तरं शुद्धं विविच्यात्तण्डुलं यथा ॥
units.translation: By the blows of reasoning, one should separate the pure inner Self from the sheaths—body, husk, and the rest—just as rice is separated from its husk.

units.label: Verse 17
units.deva:
सदा सर्वगतोऽप्यात्मा न सर्वत्रावभासते ।
बुद्धावेवावभासेत स्वच्छेषु प्रतिबिम्बवत् ॥
units.translation: Although the Self is always present everywhere, it is not manifest in every place; it shines in the intellect alone, like a reflection in clear surfaces.

units.label: Verse 18
units.deva:
देहेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिप्रकृतिभ्यो विलक्षणम् ।
तद्वृत्तिसाक्षिणं विद्यादात्मानं राजवत्सदा ॥
units.translation: One should always know the Self as distinct from the body, senses, mind, intellect, and primordial nature, and as witness to their operations, like a king.

units.label: Verse 19
units.deva:
व्यापृतेष्विन्द्रियेष्वात्मा व्यापारीवाविवेकिनाम् ।
दृश्यतेऽभ्रेषु धावत्सु धावन्निव यथा शशी ॥
units.translation: When the senses are active, the Self appears to the undiscerning to be active, as the moon seems to run when clouds race across the sky.

units.label: Verse 20
units.deva:
आत्मचैतन्यमाश्रित्य देहेन्द्रियमनोधियः ।
स्वक्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्ते सूर्यालोकं यथा जनाः ॥
units.translation: Relying on the consciousness of the Self, the body, senses, mind, and intellect function in their respective activities, as people do by the sunlight.

gloss.en: in their own actions and purposes

units.label: Verse 21
units.deva:
देहेन्द्रियगुणान्कर्माण्यमले सच्चिदात्मनि ।
अध्यस्यन्त्यविवेकेन गगने नीलतादिवत् ॥
units.translation: Through lack of discernment, people superimpose the body's, senses', and actions' properties upon the stainless Self of being and consciousness, as blueness and the like are attributed to the sky.

gloss.en: the properties of body and senses
on the Self whose nature is being and consciousness
as with blueness and the like

units.label: Verse 22
units.deva:
अज्ञानान्मानसोपाधेः कर्तृत्वादीनि चात्मनि ।
कल्प्यन्तेऽम्बुगते चन्द्रे चलनादि यथाम्भसः ॥
units.translation: Through ignorance and the mind as a limiting adjunct, agency and the like are imagined in the Self, as motion is imagined in the moon reflected in water because the water moves.

gloss.en: because of the mind as limiting adjunct

units.label: Verse 23
units.deva:
रागेच्छासुखदुःखादि बुद्धौ सत्यां प्रवर्तते ।
सुषुप्तौ नास्ति तन्नाशे तस्माद्बुद्धेस्तु नात्मनः ॥
units.translation: Attachment, desire, pleasure, pain, and the like arise when the intellect is present. They are absent in deep sleep and when the intellect ceases; therefore they belong to the intellect, not the Self.

units.label: Verse 24
units.deva:
प्रकाशोऽर्कस्य तोयस्य शैत्यमग्नेर्यथोष्णता ।
स्वभावः सच्चिदानन्दनित्यनिर्मलतात्मनः ॥
units.translation: Just as radiance is the nature of the sun, coolness of water, and heat of fire, so being-consciousness-bliss, eternality, and purity are the nature of the Self.

units.label: Verse 25
units.deva:
आत्मनः सच्चिदंशश्च बुद्धेर्वृत्तिरिति द्वयम् ।
संयोज्य चाविवेकेन जानामीति प्रवर्तते ॥
units.translation: The being-and-consciousness aspect of the Self and a thought of the intellect are two things which, joined through non-discrimination, give rise to the notion “I know.”

gloss.en: the aspect of being and consciousness

units.label: Verse 26
units.deva:
आत्मनो विक्रिया नास्ति बुद्धेर्बोधो न जात्वपि ।
जीवः सर्वमलं ज्ञात्वा ज्ञाता द्रष्टेति मुह्यति ॥
units.translation: The Self undergoes no change, and the intellect has no awareness in itself; yet the individual, taking itself to know everything, is deluded into thinking, “I am the knower and seer.”

gloss.en: the whole field of knowable things

units.label: Verse 27
units.deva:
रज्जुसर्पवदात्मानं जीवं ज्ञात्वा भयं वहेत् ।
नाहं जीवः परात्मेति ज्ञातश्चेन्निर्भयो भवेत् ॥
units.translation: Taking the Self to be the individual, as one mistakes a rope for a snake, one bears fear. If one knows, “I am not the individual; I am the Supreme Self,” one becomes fearless.

gloss.en: as with a rope mistaken for a snake

units.label: Verse 28
units.deva:
आत्मावभासयत्येको बुद्ध्यादीनीन्द्रियाणि हि ।
दीपो घटादिवत्स्वात्मा जडैस्तैर्नावभास्यते ॥
units.translation: The one Self illumines the intellect and the senses, just as a lamp illumines a pot and other things; the Self is not illumined by those inert instruments.

gloss.en: as with a pot and the like

units.label: Verse 29
units.deva:
स्वबोधे नान्यबोधेच्छा बोधरूपतयात्मनः ।
न दीपस्यान्यदीपेच्छा यथा स्वात्मप्रकाशने ॥
units.translation: The Self, whose very nature is awareness, needs no other awareness to know itself, just as a lamp needs no other lamp in order to shine.

gloss.en: because of being awareness in nature

units.label: Verse 30
units.deva:
निषिध्य निखिलोपाधीन्नेति नेतीति वाक्यतः ।
विद्यादैक्यं महावाक्यैर्जीवात्मपरमात्मनोः ॥
units.translation: Having negated every limiting adjunct through the statement “not this, not this,” one should know the identity of the individual Self and the Supreme Self through the great sayings.

gloss.en: of the individual Self and the Supreme Self

units.label: Verse 31
units.deva:
आविद्यकं शरीरादि दृश्यं बुद्बुदवत्क्षरम् ।
एतद्विलक्षणं विद्यादहं ब्रह्मेति निर्मलम् ॥
units.translation: The body and all else born of ignorance are visible and perishable like bubbles. One should know the stainless “I am Brahman” as wholly different from them.

units.label: Verse 32
units.deva:
देहान्यत्वान्न मे जन्मजराकार्श्यलयादयः ।
शब्दादिविषयैः सङ्गो निरिन्द्रियतया न च ॥
units.translation: Because I am other than the body, birth, aging, wasting, dissolution, and the like are not mine; being without senses, I have no contact with sound and other sense-objects.

gloss.en: because of being other than the body

units.label: Verse 33
units.deva:
अमनस्त्वान्न मे दुःखरागद्वेषभयादयः ।
अप्राणो ह्यमनाः शुभ्र इत्यादिश्रुतिशासनात् ॥
units.translation: Because I am mindless, sorrow, attachment, aversion, fear, and the like are not mine, as scripture teaches: “breathless, mindless, pure,” and so forth.

units.label: Verse 34
units.deva:
निर्गुणो निष्क्रियो नित्यो निर्विकल्पो निरञ्जनः ।
निर्विकारो निराकारो नित्यमुक्तोऽस्मि निर्मलः ॥
units.translation: I am without qualities or activity, eternal, free from distinctions and taint, changeless, formless, ever-liberated, and stainless.

units.label: Verse 35
units.deva:
अहमाकाशवत्सर्वं बहिरन्तर्गतोऽच्युतः ।
सदा सर्वसमः सिद्धो निःसङ्गो निर्मलोऽचलः ॥
units.translation: Like space, I pervade all, within and without, and am unchanging. I am always equal in all, complete, unattached, stainless, and immovable.

units.label: Verse 36
units.deva:
नित्यशुद्धविमुक्तैकमखण्डानन्दमद्वयम् ।
सत्यं ज्ञानमनन्तं यत्परं ब्रह्माहमेव तत् ॥
units.translation: I alone am that supreme Brahman: eternal, pure, free, one, indivisible bliss, non-dual, reality, consciousness, and infinite.

units.label: Verse 37
units.deva:
एवं निरन्तरकृता ब्रह्मैवास्मीति वासना ।
हरत्यविद्याविक्षेपान्रोगानिव रसायनम् ॥
units.translation: The conviction “I alone am Brahman,” cultivated continuously in this way, removes the projections of ignorance, as a remedy removes diseases.

units.label: Verse 38
units.deva:
विविक्तदेश आसीनो विरागो विजितेन्द्रियः ।
भावयेदेकमात्मानं तमनन्तमनन्यधीः ॥
units.translation: Seated in a secluded place, dispassionate and with the senses mastered, one should contemplate the one Self, the infinite, with a mind fixed on nothing else.

gloss.en: with a mind on nothing else

units.label: Verse 39
units.deva:
आत्मन्येवाखिलं दृश्यं प्रविलाप्य धिया सुधीः ।
भावयेदेकमात्मानं निर्मलाकाशवत्सदा ॥
units.translation: With discernment, dissolving the whole field of perception into the Self alone, the wise one should always contemplate the one Self, like the stainless sky.

units.label: Verse 40
units.deva:
रूपवर्णादिकं सर्वं विहाय परमार्थवित् ।
परिपूर्णचिदानन्दस्वरूपेणावतिष्ठते ॥
units.translation: The knower of ultimate reality, relinquishing every form, color, and the rest, abides as the nature of complete consciousness and bliss.

units.label: Verse 41
units.deva:
ज्ञातृज्ञानज्ञेयभेदः परे नात्मनि विद्यते ।
चिदानन्दैकरूपत्वाद्दीप्यते स्वयमेव हि ॥
units.translation: In the supreme Self there is no distinction between knower, knowing, and known; being of the one nature of consciousness and bliss, it shines by itself.

gloss.en: because it has the one nature of consciousness and bliss

units.label: Verse 42
units.deva:
एवमात्मारणौ ध्यानमथने सततं कृते ।
उदितावगतिज्वाला सर्वाज्ञानेन्धनं दहेत् ॥
units.translation: When meditation is thus continually churned in the fire-stick of the Self, the flame of realization arises and burns all the fuel of ignorance.

gloss.en: in the Self as the fire-stick

units.label: Verse 43
units.deva:
अरुणेनेव बोधेन पूर्वं सन्तमसे हृते ।
तत आविर्भवेदात्मा स्वयमेवांशुमानिव ॥
units.translation: When the deep darkness has first been removed by knowledge, like by the dawn, the Self appears of itself, like the sun.

units.label: Verse 44
units.deva:
आत्मा तु सततं प्राप्तोऽप्यप्राप्तवदविद्यया ।
तन्नाशे प्राप्तवद्भाति स्वकण्ठाभरणं यथा ॥
units.translation: Though the Self is always attained, through ignorance it seems unattained; when ignorance is destroyed, it shines as though attained, like an ornament already around one's neck.

gloss.en: an ornament on one's own neck

units.label: Verse 45
units.deva:
स्थाणौ पुरुषवद्भ्रान्त्या कृता ब्रह्मणि जीवता ।
जीवस्य तात्त्विके रूपे तस्मिन्दृष्टे निवर्तते ॥
units.translation: Through delusion, individuality is imagined in Brahman as a person is imagined in a stump. When the individual’s true nature is seen, that imagined individuality ceases.

units.label: Verse 46
units.deva:
तत्त्वस्वरूपानुभवादुत्पन्नं ज्ञानमञ्जसा ।
अहं ममेति चाज्ञानं बाधते दिग्भ्रमादिवत् ॥
units.translation: Knowledge born directly from experiencing reality's true nature dispels the ignorance of “I” and “mine,” as it dispels confusion about direction.

units.label: Verse 47
units.deva:
सम्यग्विज्ञानवान्योगी स्वात्मन्येवाखिलं स्थितम् ।
एकं च सर्वमात्मानमीक्षते ज्ञानचक्षुषा ॥
units.translation: The yogi endowed with right knowledge sees, with the eye of wisdom, that all this is established in his own Self alone and that the one Self is everything.

units.label: Verse 48
units.deva:
आत्मैवेदं जगत्सर्वमात्मनोऽन्यन्न किंचन ।
मृदो यद्वद्घटादीनि स्वात्मानं सर्वमीक्षते ॥
units.translation: The entire world is the Self alone; nothing whatsoever is other than the Self. As pots and other forms are [nothing but] clay, the wise one sees everything as the Self.

units.label: Verse 49
units.deva:
जीवन्मुक्तस्तु तद्विद्वान्पूर्वोपाधिगुणांस्त्यजेत् ।
स सच्चिदादिधर्मत्वं भेजे भ्रमरकीटवत् ॥
units.translation: The wise one, liberated while living, should relinquish the qualities of the former limiting adjuncts; absorbed in that truth, the person takes on the nature of being and consciousness, like the worm that becomes a bee.

gloss.en: the qualities of the former limiting adjuncts
the nature of being, consciousness, and the rest
like the worm that becomes a bee

units.label: Verse 50
units.deva:
तीर्त्वा महार्णवं हत्वा रागद्वेषादिराक्षसान् ।
योगी शान्तिसमायुक्त आत्मारामो विराजते ॥
units.translation: Having crossed the great ocean and slain the demons of attachment, aversion, and the rest, the yogi, endowed with peace, delights in the Self and shines forth.

gloss.en: one who delights in the Self

units.label: Verse 51
units.deva:
बाह्यानित्यसुखासक्तिं हित्वात्मसुखनिर्वृतः ।
घटस्थदीपवच्छश्वदन्तरेव प्रकाशते ॥
units.translation: Giving up attachment to transient outer pleasures, fulfilled by the bliss of the Self, one shines continually within like a lamp enclosed in a pot.

gloss.en: like a lamp placed inside a pot

units.label: Verse 52
units.deva:
उपाधिस्थोऽपि तद्धर्मैरलिप्तो व्योमवन्मुनिः ।
सर्वविन्मूढवत्तिष्ठेदसक्तो वायुवच्चरेत् ॥
units.translation: Though present within limiting adjuncts, the sage remains untouched by their properties, like space; knowing all, one may live as if simple-minded and move unattached like the wind.

units.label: Verse 53
units.deva:
उपाधिविलयाद्विष्णौ निर्विशेषं विशेन्मुनिः ।
जले जलं वियद्व्योम्नि तेजस्तेजसि वा यथा ॥
units.translation: When the limiting adjuncts dissolve into all-pervading Viṣṇu, the sage enters undifferentiated unity, as water merges with water, space with the sky, or fire with fire.

units.label: Verse 54
units.deva:
यल्लाभान्नापरो लाभो यत्सुखान्नापरं सुखम् ।
यज्ज्ञानान्नापरं ज्ञानं तद्ब्रह्मेत्यवधारयेत् ॥
units.translation: One should ascertain as Brahman that by gaining which there is no greater gain, by whose bliss there is no greater happiness, and by whose knowledge there is no further knowledge.

units.label: Verse 55
units.deva:
यद्दृष्ट्वा नापरं दृश्यं यद्भूत्वा न पुनर्भवः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नापरं ज्ञेयं तद्ब्रह्मेत्यवधारयेत् ॥
units.translation: One should ascertain as Brahman that, having seen which there is nothing further to see, having become which there is no return to birth, and having known which there is nothing else to know.

units.label: Verse 56
units.deva:
तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधः पूर्णं सच्चिदानन्दमद्वयम् ।
अनन्तं नित्यमेकं यत्तद्ब्रह्मेत्यवधारयेत् ॥
units.translation: One should ascertain as Brahman that which fills the sides, above, and below; is being-consciousness-bliss, non-dual, infinite, eternal, and one.

units.label: Verse 57
units.deva:
अद्वयावृत्तिरूपेण वेदान्तैर्लक्ष्यतेऽव्ययम् ।
अखण्डानन्दमेकं यत्तद्ब्रह्मेत्यवधारयेत् ॥
units.translation: One should ascertain as Brahman that imperishable, indivisible bliss, the one reality indicated by Vedānta through the repeated contemplation of non-duality.

units.label: Verse 58
units.deva:
अखण्डानन्दरूपस्य तस्यानन्दलवाश्रिताः ।
ब्रह्माद्यास्तारतम्येन भवन्त्यानन्दिनोऽखिलाः ॥
units.translation: All beings, beginning with Brahmā, depend upon a mere fraction of the bliss of that indivisible bliss itself, and become joyful in graded measure.

gloss.en: of that whose nature is indivisible bliss
dependent on a tiny portion of bliss

units.label: Verse 59
units.deva:
तद्युक्तमखिलं वस्तु व्यवहारश्चिदन्वितः ।
तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म क्षीरे सर्पिरिवाखिले ॥
units.translation: Every object is connected with that, and all ordinary activity is imbued with consciousness; therefore Brahman pervades everything, like clarified butter throughout milk.

units.label: Verse 60
units.deva:
अनण्वस्थूलमह्रस्वमदीर्घमजमव्ययम् ।
अरूपगुणवर्णाख्यं तद्ब्रह्मेत्यवधारयेत् ॥
units.translation: One should ascertain as Brahman that which is neither minute nor gross, neither short nor long, unborn and imperishable, without form, qualities, color, or name.

gloss.en: without form, qualities, color, or designation

units.label: Verse 61
units.deva:
यद्भासा भास्यतेऽर्कादि भास्यैर्यत्तु न भास्यते ।
येन सर्वमिदं भाति तद्ब्रह्मेत्यवधारयेत् ॥
units.translation: One should ascertain as Brahman that by whose light the sun and other things shine, yet which is not illuminated by the things it illumines, and by which all this shines.

gloss.en: by the things to be illumined

units.label: Verse 62
units.deva:
स्वयमन्तर्बहिर्व्याप्य भासयन्नखिलं जगत् ।
ब्रह्म प्रकाशते वह्निप्रतप्तायसपिण्डवत् ॥
units.translation: Pervading both within and without and illumining the entire world, Brahman shines like a ball of iron heated by fire.

units.label: Verse 63
units.deva:
जगद्विलक्षणं ब्रह्म ब्रह्मणोऽन्यन्न किंचन ।
ब्रह्मान्यद्भाति चेन्मिथ्या यथा मरुमरीचिका ॥
units.translation: Brahman is distinct from the world, and nothing whatsoever is other than Brahman. If something appears different from Brahman, it is unreal, like a mirage in the desert.

units.label: Verse 64
units.deva:
दृश्यते श्रूयते यद्यद्ब्रह्मणोऽन्यन्न तद्भवेत् ।
तत्त्वज्ञानाच्च तद्ब्रह्म सच्चिदानन्दमद्वयम् ॥
units.translation: Whatever is seen or heard is not other than Brahman. Through knowledge of reality, it is known as that Brahman: being-consciousness-bliss, non-dual.

units.label: Verse 65
units.deva:
सर्वगं सच्चिदानन्दं ज्ञानचक्षुर्निरीक्षते ।
अज्ञानचक्षुर्नेक्षेत भास्वन्तं भानुमन्धवत् ॥
units.translation: The eye of knowledge beholds the all-pervading being-consciousness-bliss; the eye of ignorance cannot see it, as a blind person cannot see the shining sun.

units.label: Verse 66
units.deva:
श्रवणादिभिरुद्दीप्तज्ञानाग्निपरितापितः ।
जीवः सर्वमलान्मुक्तः स्वर्णवद्द्योतते स्वयम् ॥
units.translation: Heated by the blazing fire of knowledge kindled through listening and the rest, the individual self, freed from every impurity, shines by itself like gold.

units.label: Verse 67
units.deva:
हृदाकाशोदितो ह्यात्मा बोधभानुस्तमोपहृत् ।
सर्वव्यापी सर्वधारी भाति भासयतेऽखिलम् ॥
units.translation: The Self, arisen in the sky of the heart, is the sun of knowledge that removes darkness. All-pervading and the support of all, it shines and illumines everything.

gloss.en: risen in the sky of the heart

units.label: Verse 68
units.deva:
दिग्देशकालाद्यनपेक्ष्य सर्वगं शीतादिहृन्नित्यसुखं निरञ्जनम् ।
यः स्वात्मतीर्थं भजते विनिष्क्रियः स सर्ववित्सर्वगतोऽमृतो भवेत् ॥
units.translation: Whoever, free from activity, takes refuge in the sacred Self—which is independent of direction, place, time, and the like; all-pervading, removing cold and other afflictions, eternal bliss, and stainless—becomes all-knowing, all-pervading, and immortal.

gloss.en: direction, place, time, and the rest
the sacred Self as one's refuge

units.label: Colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छंकरभगवतः कृतौ आत्मबोधः संपूर्णः ॥
units.translation: Thus ends Ātmabodha, composed by the venerable Śrī Śaṅkarabhagavat, the disciple of Śrī Govinda Bhagavatpūjyapāda, the revered teacher who was a supreme swan and wandering renunciant.

gloss.en: of the teacher who is a supreme swan and wandering renunciant
of the disciple of the venerable Śrī Govinda Bhagavatpūjyapāda
